title: Primary-key-changing SQLite CDC mirror
hypothesis: A stateful change-data-capture mirror could exercise idempotency and primary-key migration if incremental work and provenance are naturally observable parts of the user contract.
why_hard: Final-state equality alone cannot distinguish a production incremental repair from replaying all input into a fresh mirror; a meaningful verifier needs a justified observable incremental obligation.
next_action: Reopen only after identifying a concrete, naturally observable incremental or provenance contract and a bounded fast fixture.

sources.note: Recorded TB proposal and reviewer exchange include a functionally passing full in-memory rebuild considered unsuitable for the intended production pipeline.

notes: Rejected for the initial pass because a naive final-state oracle permits a shallow rebuild and the proposal estimates 5.5 expert hours. This is a design-screen decision, not a local model failure or a claim that all CDC tasks are weak.
